error.message: the background click target does not identify the requested window; run get-app-state again or retry with --restore-window

nextSteps: If the message names a popup menu or `<select>`, set its option with `orca computer set-value` on that element instead of clicking.
Otherwise retry once with `--restore-window`; that brings the app forward and uses foreground input, so tell the user it will take over their screen.
